info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Carrental Reservations Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Car Rental Reservations Status API provides insights into the current status of reservations made through the car rental system. This API enables consumers to retrieve detailed information regarding their reservations, ensuring that users can easily track and manage their bookings. Typical use cases include checking reservation statuses for planning travel or confirming bookings before pick-up. It serves as a critical resource for both end-users and travel agencies seeking real-time reservation data.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of reservations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest status of their reservations. Implementing this feature enhances visibility and user experience by providing real-time updates on reservation statuses.
